checkpoint_finding.rule: A future state is target_label_unexposed only when registration choices, feature rosters, scaling, batch categories, CVAE weights, and evaluation mappings are fit without held outcomes and model training remains within participant folds.

input_eligibility.gse192741: Not applicable to the native cross-modal objective because it has Visium RNA and H&E but no spatial metabolomics. Four donors permit only future plumbing diagnostics.
input_eligibility.gse292268: Not applicable because it has CosMx RNA without spatial metabolomics; donor joins are also unresolved.
input_eligibility.hra007511: The only plausible registered MASLD ST-plus-MALDI substrate, but currently ineligible because access, section and participant joins, transforms, training rights, and derivative-weight rights are unresolved. RNA and MALDI are adjacent-section unless proven otherwise.
input_eligibility.vu2025: Not applicable to the native cross-modal objective because CODEX proteins are not MALDI or DESI metabolite intensities. DSA and donor-boundary issues independently block use.

exposure_and_leakage_findings.alignment: A query-specific transform can use all held spatial features. It is transductive preprocessing and becomes circular if the same molecular features both optimize registration and score cross-modal recovery.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.reassignment: KNN aggregation creates derived values on a common grid. These values remain adjacent-section estimates with mapping uncertainty rather than observed paired truth.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.feature_selection: Spatially variable genes and metabolites, scaling, batch definitions, and spatial-neighbor statistics are training-participant operations.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.unseen_batch: The batch-conditioned decoder does not define an automatically inductive category for a new participant. Any new learned category is query adaptation.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.assay_nulls: RNA counts and metabolite intensities require their separate native likelihoods and effect scales. A matrix-level fit cannot justify a cross-assay null-model substitution.

known_incidents_and_biases: The pinned tree has a top-level BSD-3-Clause license but contains a modified vendored STalign path whose upstream repository is GPL-3.0; exact reuse, notice, source, and redistribution obligations are unresolved.

The paper reports Chinese patent application 2025110969999 covering the algorithm, while BSD-3-Clause does not contain an explicit patent grant. Institutional review is required before an open derivative.
Vendored taming-transformers code requires provenance and notice verification, and optional paths use unrestricted torch.load.
The package bundles an HMDB-derived table whose data terms are independent of the code license.
The declared environment is inconsistent: setup.py requests scikit-learn 0.24.1 while requirements and environment files request 1.5.0.
Registration tuned on held molecular correspondence can manufacture apparent cross-modal agreement.
Adjacent sections are not same-section observations, and interpolation does not change that topology.
Spots, pixels, ion features, sections, transforms, and KNN links are not biological replicates.
remaining_blockers: Obtain an authoritative, rights-cleared participant-linked spatial RNA and MALDI or DESI dataset with section topology, assay metadata, transforms or registration inputs, sufficient participant power, and derivative-weight permission.

Resolve the modified STalign licensing and notice chain, taming-transformers provenance, the reported patent application, and every bundled data asset before code reuse, adaptation, or redistribution.

Register a modality-native TaskSpec with independent registration and evaluation features, participant-level endpoints, assay-native baselines and nulls, external source, power, uncertainty, and champion gate.

Freeze registration and KNN reassignment before held outcomes: inputs, coordinate units, outlines or landmarks, affine and nonlinear stages, objective, initialization, K, distance threshold, aggregation, transform hash, and per-observation mapping uncertainty.
Define and fixture-test the frozen-encoder behavior for an unseen participant and the batch-conditioned decoder's unseen-category policy; report query registration or adaptation as transductive.
Resolve the exact runtime lock, including the scikit-learn conflict, and replace unrestricted checkpoint loading with a strict tensor-only state and schema-validated metadata path.

After activation and campaign approval, pass assay-native likelihood, registration non-circularity, donor block, load, forward, backward, resume, deterministic seed, no-network, and cross-device probes through SLURM.
Hash every participant-fold registration, feature roster, environment, and trained state before selection.
interpretation: SpatialMETA is not a generic multimodal spatial model. It is specifically designed for spatial RNA counts and spatial metabolite intensities, usually after registration and reassignment across sections. Only HRA007511 plausibly matches that design, and it is controlled, adjacent-section, project-exposed, and rights-blocked. The lack of a task and hold back, plus unresolved vendored-code and patent terms, keeps SpatialMETA outside v1.
